settings.heading: We're here to help
settings.text: Questions about a piece, an order or delivery to your country? Real people answer every message.

settings.question: How long does shipping take?
settings.answer: Most orders arrive within 2–3 weeks. Delivery can take a little longer for larger or heavier orders. You'll get a tracking number by email when your order ships.

settings.question: Do you ship internationally?
settings.answer: Yes. Shipping is free on every order and tracked. Choose your country at the top of the page to see prices in your currency. Any customs duties or taxes charged by your country are paid by the customer.

settings.question: My tracking number shows as invalid. Why?
settings.answer: Tracking numbers can take up to 48 hours to become active. If it still doesn't work after that, email support@luxedealers.com with your order number.
